test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Book - debts are recorded in the credit column of the trial balance.
Cash in hand is recorded in the credit column of the trial balance.
The trial balance contains balances of only personal and real accounts.
The balance of the liabilities account is shown in the credit column of the trial balance.

solution:
The correct answer is **The balance of the liabilities account is shown in the credit column of the trial balance.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **The balance of the liabilities account is shown in the credit column of the trial balance:**

 
 
• In accounting, liabilities represent the financial obligations of a business. These are amounts the business owes to external parties, such as loans, accounts payable, and other debts.
 
• Liabilities are recorded on the credit side of the trial balance because they represent amounts that the business needs to pay in the future.
 
• The trial balance is a statement that lists the balances of all ledger accounts. It helps ensure that the total debits equal the total credits, maintaining the accounting equation.
 
• By showing liabilities in the credit column, the trial balance accurately reflects the financial position of the business.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Book-debts are recorded in the credit column of the trial balance:**

 
 
• This is incorrect. Book-debts, or accounts receivable, represent amounts owed to the business by its customers. These are assets and are recorded in the debit column of the trial balance.
 
 
 
• **Cash in hand is recorded in the credit column of the trial balance:**
 
 
• Incorrect. Cash in hand is an asset and is recorded in the debit column of the trial balance.
 
 
 
• **The trial balance contains balances of only personal and real accounts:**
 
 
• This statement is incorrect. The trial balance contains balances of all types of accounts, including personal, real, and nominal accounts.
